decision: Delinquency buckets are one stacked bar that sweeps in, darker as debt ages
why: The question is the shape of the book, not four separate numbers; darker ink for older buckets matches how risk grows.
value: Roll-forward problems are visible at a glance.

decision: Contact strategy is a readable table per segment with quiet hours stated up front
why: Collections is regulated and emotional; agents need to see why a customer gets a WhatsApp at lunch and not a call at 21:30.
alternative: Hard-coded cadences hidden in a dialer.
value: Compliant by construction, and easy to explain to a customer.

decision: The agreement builder prices installments with a unit-tested PMT function that recalculates on every change
why: Agents negotiate live on the phone; the number they say must be the number the link charges.
alternative: Look up installment tables in a spreadsheet.
value: No re-quotes, no disputes about what was promised.

decision: The AI suggests the best time and channel per segment, from contact outcomes
why: Reply rates double at the right time; the suggestion cites outcomes and the quiet-hours policy it never overrides.
value: More promises kept with fewer contacts.

decision: Recoveries tick up from installment payments in the in-browser world
why: The page should feel like a live book without a payments backend per visitor.
value: Live and credible at $0; pausable like every live screen.
